'''Getting started''' with [[Star Wars CCG]] takes two players and two 60-card decks, one for the [[Side|Light Side]] and one for the Dark Side. Each card in your deck represents one unit of Force. You win by depleting your opponent's [[Life Force]].<ref name="rb20">[[Media:Decipher Rulebook 2.0.pdf|Star Wars Customizable Card Game Rulebook, Version 2.0]], Decipher (November 1998), pp. 1–12. [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0|Wiki transcription]].</ref>

== Play with printed cards ==

Start with one ready-to-play deck for each side. [[Decipher]]'s [[Special Edition]] rulebook introduces the 60 cards supplied with the booklet as a player's first deck.<ref name="rb20" /> For product examples, see the [[Premiere Two-Player Introductory Game]], [[The Empire Strikes Back Introductory Two-Player Game]] and [[Death Star II Starter Decks]]. Before building your own decks, agree on a [[Formats|format]] and look through the [[Decklists]].

== Set up a basic game ==

For a first game using the starting-location procedure in Decipher's rulebook, follow these steps.<ref name="rb20" />

# Each player chooses a starting [[Location|location]] from their deck and places it face down. Generic sites cannot start the game. Reveal both locations at the same time. If they have the same title, set them aside and repeat until the titles differ. Return the set-aside cards to their decks.
# Put the starting locations face up, with the blue Force icons facing the Light Side player and the red Force icons facing the Dark Side player. Keep locations from the same planet together.
# Shuffle the remaining cards into a face-down Reserve Deck and draw eight cards from the top for your starting hand.
# The Dark Side takes the first turn. The six [[Phase|phases]] of each turn are Activate, Control, Deploy, Battle, Move and Draw.

== Play a turn ==

Activate Force by moving cards face down from your Reserve Deck to your Force Pile. In Control, you can drain Force at locations you control. In Deploy, you can bring cards into play. In Battle, you can initiate a battle at an eligible location. In Move, you can move cards where the rules allow. In Draw, you may take cards from your Force Pile into your hand.<ref name="rb20" />

The Reserve Deck, Force Pile and Used Pile together make up your Life Force. To pay for actions that use Force, move cards from the Force Pile to the Used Pile. At the end of each turn, both players return their Used Piles to the bottoms of their Reserve Decks.<ref name="rb20" />

== Learn the rules ==

* [[How to play]] gives a short overview.
* [[Card Layout]] explains where to find the printed values, icons and game text on a card.
* [[Star Wars Customizable Card Game RULEBOOK 2.0|Decipher's 1998 rulebook]] teaches the basic procedures. Use the [[Decipher Glossary 2.0]] and [[Decipher Glossary Supplement]] for Decipher-era rulings.
* [[Players Committee Advanced Rulebook]] covers Players Committee rules, including starting procedures for [[Objective|Objectives]]. See [[Rulebooks]] for the document that matches your format.
